g.text: 3. Top of Mid surveyed station · floorZ -0.098m
126 explicit reviewed horizontal sections; dots are collision endpoints. Hover for ID, height, feature and limitations.
Cyan/gold lines are chords through open space, including reviewed local cover gaps. They are NOT boundary walls.
Green squares: repeated floor/first-overhead columns. Numbered white circles:13 native floor datums.
Panels separate evidence by ray height, not complete floor stories. Source datum0 is a coordinate convention.
Grid spacing12.7m. CSV stores calibrated endpoint XYZ and measured length; no hidden geometry is interpolated.
Source repeatability and centimeter conversion do not bound render/collision offsets or minimum body clearance.
Remaining: full apertures, cover masses, ramp endpoints, continuous architectural outlines and overlapping elevation layers.
